result:
I didn't measure anything, so there are no offline seconds, control seconds or raid result. My command list has no way to serve a build on a test port or to start Chrome with the `--host-resolver-rules` flag. The server start (`tools/serve.ps1` on port 8861) was refused. The only Chrome start I'm allowed has no way to add that flag. I made no game change and shipped nothing.

From reading the code, offline linking looks likely to work:
- **Gathering wait:** the host and player 2 each wait for ICE gathering to finish, up to 5 s (`NET_WAIT_ICE`). They go one after the other.
- **Names that fail at once:** the outside lookups should fail fast, so each side should take well under a second.
- **Wifi that swallows lookups:** each side could wait the full 5 s, about 10 s plus the link itself. That is under the 15 s line but close.
- **The link itself:** on one PC it uses host candidates and doesn't need the outside servers.

If a real run shows it over 15 s, the fix is a short wait (about 1 s) for the same-machine arcade link only. It would ship with a check that fails on the old build.

The notes are in `tools/handoff/console/notes/47-check-demo-link-offline.md`. I also added a line to `alarms.md` saying this needs a session with permission to serve the build and start Chrome with the flag.
